# Anycode v0.1.1

Anycode v0.1.1 upgrades the integrated terminal emulator to `@wterm/dom` with `@wterm/ghostty` (`libghostty-vt` WASM), adding native line reflow on resize, improved scrollback retention, and expanded E2E test coverage.

## Terminal and UI

- Migrated the integrated terminal to `@wterm/dom` with `@wterm/ghostty` (`libghostty-vt` WASM core) for native line reflow when resizing terminal panes.
- Preserved terminal scroll position, bottom-pinning, and output snapshots across Dockview tab switches and page reloads.
- Queried terminal mouse tracking state directly from the WASM bridge and aligned snapshot trimming to line boundaries.
- Refined terminal container horizontal padding and bottom row padding alignment.

## Testing

- Expanded Playwright E2E terminal test suite covering interactive banner/prompt rendering, VFS commands, resize reflow, tab-switch scroll preservation, snapshot restoration on reload, and terminal word selection quoting into ACP agent prompts.

**Full comparison:** `v0.1.0...v0.1.1`
